settings.heading: How do I choose a compatible case?
settings.row_content: Select the exact device model listed in the product options. Similar device names do not guarantee the same fit.

settings.heading: How is my personalization saved?
settings.row_content: When personalization is enabled, the selected name, style, colour and placement are saved with the item in your bag.

settings.heading: When will my order ship?
settings.row_content: Use the delivery estimate shown at checkout and the store's published shipping policy. Do not rely on an estimate from a different product.

settings.heading: Can a personalized item be returned?
settings.row_content: Eligibility follows the current published refund policy. Review that policy before ordering a personalized product.
